entries.a5d21a982f7365fa: As its management policy for the year, it sets out "Responding to a New Economic Environment," citing the continuation of a stable profitable structure, the realization of a highly profitable structure by taking on the challenge of new revenue, the review of businesses from a long-term perspective, and the establishment of "safety and trust" through legal compliance and the thorough implementation of a crisis management structure. With the transportation business, including the highly public route bus business, as its core business, it also develops the real estate business, the product sales business, the travel business, the inn business and the aviation agency business, and states that, treasuring its "bonds with local communities," it aims to realize a safe and secure society, beginning with transportation safety.
